title: Archive through February 26, 2002 - Anonymous (prime.kapa.net - 206.135.162.167) (Tuesday, February 26, 2002 - 11:12 am)
content: Experience Narrative: I had recently gotten separated from my ex-husband. He had tried to run me over with my own car. He was stalking me and wanted to kill me. My brother had tried killing me three months before, I tried to kill myself. I never went to the light. I was miserable wanted to die, I have four children and my health began to deteriate. I felt that I was going to be a horrible mother because of the craziness I had gone through that year. I called my cousin and told her that my children needed someone to come and care for them. I believed I had lost my self. I felt week and insecure living one horror after another. I was sick of life. I went into the bathroom and locked the door. There I drank a 1/5 of whiskey and swallowed a bottle of sleeping pills. I really don't remember how I got from there to the hospital. I was begging them to let me die. I was in the emergency room and I could see the nurses and the doctors cutting off my clothes. I saw an oriental nurse and a young white doctor with round rim glasses looking at me. I was feeling no pain. I was watching from the upper corner of the room above everyone. When, I saw a dark cloud and the cloud began to separate. As the cloud separated a light began to shine through. As it began to shine I reached for the light and was embraced in the warm of it. I saw the future I saw In the past. I felt and knew that I was part of all things. I wanted to stay but I was sent back. I was told it was not my time to die. So I am back. I am a single mother of four children. Now I am a grandmother of three beautiful grandchildren all born within two months of each other. I have two bachelor degrees and working on my masters in sociology. I still get very ill from allergies. I have had more out of body experiences from allergy reactions. But have not seen the light again**

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Watching from the upper corner of the emergency room above everyone.

arrival.other_being_detail: A dark cloud separated and a light shone through; the experiencer reached for the light and was embraced by its warmth; later reports being told it was not her time to die (speaker not identified).

environment.environment_other_detail: Light shining through a separating dark cloud; felt embraced in the warmth of the light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drank a fifth of whiskey and swallowed a bottle of sleeping pills.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dark cloud separating with light shining through; perceived past and future; sense of being part of all things.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in emergency room followed by dark cloud/light, then being told it was not her time and sent back; no tunnel reported.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Reports having more out-of-body experiences later due to allergy reactions, but not seeing the light again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: States, "I never went to the light" earlier, yet later describes a light shining through a separating dark cloud and being embraced by it.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was watching from the upper corner of the room above everyone." "As the cloud separated a light began to shine through." "I felt and knew that I was part of all things." "I was told it was not my time to die."
